title: 5.6 Meals
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Recognize breakfast, lunch, and dinner and say what familiar food or drink is consumed for each meal.
prerequisite: 4.5 Morning Routine, 4.8 Days and Time; 5.2 foods and drinks.
speaking_outcome: Name the three meals and say three complete meal sentences.

cards.pedagogy_note: New meal anchor; use night context already known.
Review we and plural simple present.
Uses a proven two-choice set and a decisive morning-versus-night contrast.
Controls the scene so no distractor action or item is also visibly true.
